got.translation: When will I receive my tax receipt?
got.draft:
Estimada María López,

Gracias por su consulta. Nuestro equipo le enviará su recibo de impuestos por correo electrónico dentro de las 48 horas siguientes a cada donación mensual. Además, recibirá un resumen anual de todas sus donaciones antes del 31 de enero del siguiente año.

Si necesita una copia de algún recibo anterior, podemos reenviársela en un plazo de 2 días hábiles.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Should state receipt timing from policy (online vs. check).

got.draft:
Estimada María López,

Muchas gracias por su amable mensaje y por su generoso apoyo continuo a nuestra misión.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Short message; KB must be skipped.

text: Merci, mais veuillez me retirer de votre liste.

got.translation: Thanks, but please remove me from your list.
got.draft:
Chère Claire Dubois,

Merci pour votre message. Nous allons traiter votre demande de désinscription de notre liste de diffusion. Cette action sera effectuée dans un délai de 5 jours ouvrés.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Starts with thanks but intent is unsubscribe. Should not ask why.

text: Count me in for $50 a month starting in December.

got.draft:
Dear Sam Taylor,

Thank you for your generous pledge of $50 per month, starting in December. We are delighted by your support for our mission to bring books and reading support to children.

To complete your recurring gift setup, please visit our donation page at your convenience. Our team will then process your request, and your first donation will be charged in December.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Same language as campaign; translation should be skipped.

text: I was charged twice for my donation last week. Please fix this.

got.draft:
Dear Sam Taylor,

Thank you for letting us know about the duplicate charge. To help us investigate, could you please provide the exact date and amount of the two charges? Our Donor Care team will review this information within 2 business days. If a duplicate is confirmed, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Should apologize once and give a concrete next step.

got.draft:
Dear Sam Taylor,

Thank you for your question. Yes, your gift to Lanternwood Reading Alliance is tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law, as we are a registered 501(c)(3) public charity. Your receipt will provide the necessary details for your records. If you received something in return for your donation, only the amount above the value of that item is deductible.

Please consult a tax advisor for guidance specific to your situation.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Must not give tax advice beyond what the policy doc says.

text: Quiero donar 100 dólares para los libros de los niños. ¿Cómo lo hago?

got.translation: I want to donate $100 for children's books. How do I do it?
got.draft:
Estimada María López,

Muchas gracias por su interés en donar $100 para los libros de los niños. Para realizar su donación, puede hacerlo en línea y seleccionar "Book Bundles" o "Reading Bridge" según su preferencia. Si desea apoyar nuestra campaña actual "Spring Story Drive", elija esa opción al donar.

Un miembro de nuestro equipo se pondrá en contacto con usted en breve para coordinar los detalles y confirmar su donación.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Mixed intent; should explain how to give.

text: no he recibido mi recibo y ya pasaron 3 semanas

got.translation: I haven't received my receipt and it's been 3 weeks
got.draft:
Estimada María López:

Gracias por su mensaje. Lamentamos que aún no haya recibido su recibo. Nuestro equipo revisará su solicitud y le reenviará el recibo correspondiente en un plazo de 2 días hábiles.

Para ayudarnos a localizar su donación, ¿podría confirmarnos la fecha y el monto de la misma? Si lo prefiere, también podemos enviarle un resumen de todas sus donaciones del año.

Le estaremos contactando únicamente por correo electrónico.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: No accents or capitals; overdue receipt.

text: Est-ce que je peux faire un don par chèque ?

got.draft:
Bonjour Claire Dubois,

Oui, vous pouvez faire un don par chèque. Veuillez le libeller à l'ordre de "Lanternwood Reading Alliance" et indiquer "Pledge" sur la ligne de mémo.

Notre équipe vous remercie pour votre soutien.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Payment-method question.

text: Merci beaucoup pour la belle lettre, mes enfants adorent la bibliothèque !

got.translation: Thank you so much for the nice letter, my kids love the library!
got.draft:
Chère Claire Dubois,

Merci pour votre message si gentil. Nous sommes ravis d'apprendre que vos enfants aiment tant la bibliothèque.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Longer thank-you; KB skipped.

text: 请不要再给我发邮件了。

got.draft:
Wei Chen，您好：

感谢您告知我们。我们的团队将在5个工作日内处理您的退订请求，您将不再收到我们的筹款邮件。

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Non-Latin script; reply must be in Chinese.

text: 我的捐款收据什么时候寄出？

got.translation: When will my donation receipt be sent out?
got.draft:
Wei Chen，您好！

感谢您的捐款。根据我们的政策，在线捐款的电子收据会在捐款后48小时内发出。如果您是通过支票或邮寄方式捐款，我们会在收到捐款后的10个工作日内寄出收据。

如果您尚未收到，请提供您的捐款日期和方式，以便我们为您查询。我们的团队将在2个工作日内为您处理。

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Non-Latin script receipt question.

text: Love what you do but I'm getting way too many emails. Can you take me off?

got.draft:
Dear Sam Taylor,

Thank you for your support. We will process your request to unsubscribe from all fundraising emails within 5 business days.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Positive tone, but the request is to unsubscribe.

got.draft:
Dear Sam Taylor,

Thank you for your kind message and for your generous support.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Very short; language detection may be low confidence and fall back to campaign default.

text: Do you have volunteer opportunities on weekends?

got.draft:
Dear Sam Taylor,

Thank you for your interest in volunteering. According to our policy, volunteer tutors must attend one 3-hour training session and commit to at least four weeks. The policy does not specify if these opportunities are available on weekends.

A member of our team will follow up with you to provide more specific details about the schedule and availability.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Not covered by the KB; draft must not invent a policy and should say staff will follow up.

text: Hi, quiero cancelar mi monthly donation please

got.draft:
Dear María López,

Thank you for your message regarding your monthly donation. To process your cancellation request, please reply to this email or contact Donor Care directly at donorcare@lanternwood.example. Our team will handle your request promptly.

As noted in our policy, changes received by the 20th of the month take effect with the next month's charge. You will receive a confirmation once the cancellation is processed.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Code-switching; detected language may be es or en. Cancelling a recurring gift is not the same as unsubscribing from email.

text: Es la tercera vez que me llaman pidiendo dinero. Ya basta.

got.translation: This is the third time they've called me asking for money. That's enough.
got.draft:
Estimada María López:

Lamentamos sinceramente que haya recibido llamadas no deseadas. Su preferencia registrada indica que solo desea contacto por correo electrónico. Hemos registrado su queja y nuestro equipo de atención al donante la revisará para asegurar que se respeten sus preferencias de comunicación. El equipo se pondrá en contacto con usted en un plazo de 7 días hábiles para confirmar la resolución.

Si desea modificar sus preferencias de contacto o pausar las comunicaciones, puede indicárnoslo en su respuesta.

Atentamente,
Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Frustrated, negative sentiment.

got.draft:
Thank you for your kind and generous support, Sam Taylor. It means a great deal to us.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: No words; detection should fall back to campaign default without crashing.

text: Je souhaite renouveler mon don de 200 € cette année.

got.translation: I want to renew my €200 donation this year.
got.draft:
Chère Claire Dubois,

Merci beaucoup pour votre intention de renouveler votre don de 200 € cette année. Nous sommes très touchés par votre soutien continu.

Notre équipe va vous envoyer une confirmation écrite de cet engagement dans les 3 jours ouvrables. Cette confirmation détaillera le montant total et les options de paiement disponibles.

Un membre de l'équipe vous contactera également pour convenir de votre calendrier de paiement préféré.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Euro amount; reply should not convert currency.

text: Great, another fundraising email. Exactly what I needed today.

got.draft:
Dear Sam Taylor,

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We sincerely apologize that our recent email was unwelcome. We respect your inbox and will honor your communication preferences.

If you would like to stop receiving our fundraising emails, please reply to this message and we will process your unsubscribe request within 5 business days. Alternatively, if you would prefer fewer emails, we can adjust your preferences to receive only quarterly updates.

A member of our team will be happy to assist you.

Lanternwood Reading Alliance

notes: Sarcasm; sentiment should be negative, not positive.
